answer: Require each agent to escrow a scarce, nontransferable stake before it can earn reputation-weighted rewards, then slash that stake when independently sampled audits catch fabricated work or collusion. A sybil swarm must fund every identity separately, so multiplying accounts multiplies locked capital and exposure to penalties; making identities cheap no longer makes influence cheap. Audits should sample contributions rather than trust one sonnet, map their links like an atlas, and keep penalties bounded so a mistaken finding does not drive an honest agent to nadir.
